title: Periodic Quarter-Wave Reference Stack
scientific_hypothesis: A periodic quarter-wave stack with fixed optical thickness at the geometric mean wavelength will achieve moderate reflectance reduction in both bands but cannot minimize both simultaneously.
design_principle: Quarter-wave stacks create destructive interference at the design wavelength; using the geometric mean of the two bands (approximately 1400 nm) positions the reflectance minimum between the bands, providing a physics-based baseline for comparison.
proposed_topology: air | ta2o5 | sio2 | ta2o5 | sio2 | ta2o5 | sio2 | si (7 layers total: 3 high-low pairs plus substrate)
design_variables: individual layer thicknesses for all 6 coating layers, each varied between 20-400 nm
soft_objectives: minimize average reflectance across 1260-1360 nm band
minimize average reflectance across 1530-1565 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: 6 coating layers within 12-layer maximum provides margin for fabrication tolerance
all thicknesses within 20-400 nm manufacturable range
ta2o5 and sio2 are standard sputtering materials
theory_basis: Quarter-wave condition: optical thickness = lambda/4 at design wavelength
Transfer matrix method for multilayer reflectance calculation
Geometric mean wavelength for dual-band centering
expected_advantages: Low layer count reduces fabrication complexity
known_risks: Reflectance minimum positioned between bands may leave both bands suboptimal
Fixed pair count limits optimization freedom
May not achieve lowest possible reflectance in either band
execution_request_english: Design a periodic quarter-wave anti-reflection coating on silicon substrate. Incident medium: air. Substrate: semi-infinite si. Coating stack: Ta2O5 (Gao) | SiO2 (Lemarchand) | Ta2O5 (Gao) | SiO2 (Lemarchand) | Ta2O5 (Gao) | SiO2 (Lemarchand) (6 layers, 3 pairs). Wavelength bands: 1260-1360 nm and 1530-1565 nm. Incidence: 0 deg, unpolarized. Optimize all 6 layer thicknesses independently within 20-400 nm range. Objective: minimize average reflectance across both bands combined. Report best_target_score, valid_candidates, tightest_margin, thicknesses_nm, and band-specific average reflectance and transmittance into silicon.
